title: Path traversal vulnerability: the `filename` URL parameter is passed directly to `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)` on
description: Path traversal vulnerability: the `filename` URL parameter is passed directly to `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, filename)` on line 22 without sanitizing path traversal sequences. An attacker can supply `../../../etc/passwd` to read arbitrary files outside the uploads directory. Validate that the resolved path starts with UPLOAD_DIR using `os.path.realpath()` or use Flask's `safe_join()` utility.
